create.name: Diana Beaulieu
create.bio:
Diana Beaulieu teaches what she calls Womb Awakening, a body-based spiritual practice for women that joins energy work, shamanic journeying and the sacred feminine. She first trained as a scientist, reading biology and human sciences at Oxford and taking a postgraduate degree in environmental anthropology at UCL, and worked for a time as a researcher and anthropologist in Latin America. A personal crisis turned her towards complementary practice: she spent ten years with Shiatsu, worked in frontline women's and addiction services, performed goddess stories as a storyteller, and then served a seven-year apprenticeship in core shamanism.

Out of her own healing from early trauma came the InnerWomb Method, which she now teaches online. Her self-paced courses lead women through practices for sensing and releasing emotion held in the pelvis, listening to the womb's intuition and reclaiming creative and feminine power, and a separate five-week course teaches drum-led shamanic journeys to the Lower World and meeting a power animal. She also runs a free three-week introduction and a practitioner training for those who want to work with clients. Her YouTube channel holds masterclasses, global meditations and recorded conversations on feminine archetypes.

courses.title: Womb Healing Online Course
courses.description: A self-paced online journey in eight parts, delivered as weekly audio and written classes, with lifetime access to a support group. The classes cover sensing the womb's energy, releasing held emotion through energy practice, ancestral feminine wounds and healthier boundaries.

courses.title: Three Week Womb Activation Course
courses.description: A short three-week introduction to the InnerWomb Method: embodied energy practices for reconnecting with the womb, hearing its intuition and setting personal intentions for the work ahead.

courses.title: Shamanic Journeying Course
courses.description: A five-week on-demand course in shamanic journeying with the drum, with five recorded video classes, guided journeys and a members' forum. It covers safe journeying, the three worlds, travelling to the Lower World and working with a power animal.

courses.title: InnerWomb Method Practitioner Training
courses.description: A multi-level online training for women who want to guide clients through womb awakening work, combining their own healing programme with energy theory, facilitation skills and session scripts. The next cohort is due in April 2027; registration had not yet opened.

free_resources.title: Free Womb Healing Course
free_resources.description: A free three-week introduction to her womb practices, sent by email after sign-up, for women new to the work or curious about it.
